evals.prompt: There's a huge story breaking today about AI agents replacing junior developers. We make a code-review tool. How do we get our take in front of journalists fast?
evals.expected_output: Should check for product-marketing.md first. Should identify this as reactive newsjacking and emphasize speed over polish (a B+ pitch in the first hours beats an A+ pitch on day three). Should reference the newsjacking workflow (detect -> score newsworthiness -> craft angle -> pitch) and warn that the story must be the trend/data/conflict, not the product. Should propose a specific POV/angle tied to the company's evidence and a short, journalist-respecting pitch.
assertions: Frames story around the trend, not the product
Proposes a specific angle and concise pitch

evals.prompt: We just hit 10,000 customers and have proprietary data on how teams actually use AI at work. I want coverage in tech press. Help me pitch this.
evals.expected_output: Should treat this as proactive pitching. Should help shape the proprietary data into a story (the data/trend is the story; the product is the evidence). Should recommend building a targeted media list and scoring journalist fit, and reference the journalist-pitching workflow with subject-line craft and follow-up cadence. Should push for founder/exec quotes and a clear destination (press page/blog) that converts attention. Should distinguish this from directory submissions and launch.
assertions: Shapes proprietary data into a story angle

evals.prompt: How do I use HARO / Connectively and Qwoted to get press mentions without spending hours every day?
evals.expected_output: Should identify this as the inbound press-request mode and reference the press-platforms workflow. Should describe a daily triage loop (scan queries, filter for fit, respond fast with a tight template), set expectations on ROI, and emphasize relevance and credibility over volume. Should note these are journalist-driven and keep scope distinct from directories.
assertions: Provides or references a response template

evals.prompt: 우리는 한국 스타트업인데 언론 보도를 받고 싶어요. 보도자료랑 프레스 페이지부터 어떻게 준비하죠?
evals.expected_output: Should check product-marketing.md and cover the owned-media foundation (press page + media kit) so journalists can find and quote you. Should apply the Korea adaptation: domestic distribution and outlets (뉴스와이어 보도자료 배포, 플래텀·아웃스탠딩·전자신문 등 스타트업·테크 매체), Korean press-release structure (제목·부제·리드·본문·문의처) and formal tone, and note that English-only services like HARO are limited domestically. Should keep claims evidence-based and suggest kr-ad-compliance for any exaggerated wording.
assertions: Covers owned media (press page + media kit)
References Korean press-release format and formal tone
Notes HARO/English services are limited in Korea
